entries.description: Completing a B.S. in Information Systems through the Marriott School of Business, with a Software & Systems Development emphasis in a STEM-certified technical program (expected May 2028). Accepted into the Master of Information Systems Management (MISM) program and beginning Fall 2027 with an expected completion of May 2029. Academic focus includes software development, data analytics, financial technology, systems design, and business-focused technology strategy.
